prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 34 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1095; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Treatment summary, provider perspective. The patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection and reports neck pain consistent with whiplash. The mechanism and force of the collision are reasonably consistent with the reported injury. Over the course of care, the patient has attended 34 visits, with near-daily attendance for much of that period. Additional body regions were added to the complaint several weeks after the collision. Nearly all findings documented to date rest on the patient's self-reported pain levels and symptom descriptions. Cervical and related imaging were unremarkable, and the physical examination tests performed were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same region is known from the patient's history. Two charges of similar type on the same day are currently under review for accuracy. Ongoing care and the final plan will be revisited once the review is complete.
